why: Apps with email or social login (Privy, Magic, Coinbase, Para...) give you a separate wallet in each app. No public API lists them, so a scan of one address cannot see them: list them yourself, then scan each address.

where.how: log in with the same email the apps used, then link your Google, X or phone there: every Privy app you used shows with its wallet, and each app's key can be exported, even for apps that shut down
put the app's name in the link (e.g. https://reveal.magic.link/polymarket) and log in with the same email; only for apps that turned it on
sign in with the passkey you made (keys.coinbase.com now leads here); one wallet for every app
log in with the same email or phone: lists, connects and exports your Para wallet

then: scan each address you find. Smart accounts those addresses own (Coinbase, Kernel, LightAccount, Biconomy, thirdweb, Safe...) come back in the same scan. Never paste a private key or seed phrase into any site or chat to do this.
